field_outputs.question: Do existing AutoML / MF ensembles cover learned full-field surrogates?
field_outputs.status: Resolved: LANE-SI already learns field combinations; EL-MFS, AQBMF and MAESTRO cover adaptive MF ensembles. Restrict contribution to the specific common-deployment workflow and its evaluation, not first field AutoML.

automation.question: Is singleton/inverse/full rule selection novel?
automation.status: No algorithmic priority claim. ERA5 complete selector chooses full, which loses to inverse weighting at evaluation. Broader selector validation and exact-library Caruana control remain gaps.

calibration.question: Does k=5 prove low total HF cost?
calibration.status: No; k is additional, most training tables have N_L=N_H=400.

generality.question: Does procedure generalize to untrained PDEs?
generality.status: No; base experts are per-dataset. Test new inputs and fixed procedure separately.

climate.question: Can ERA5 establish impact?
climate.status: Repaired ERA5 complete: inverse gives modest 2.35% K5 relative gain vs strong mean; automatic/full worsens 0.53%. Seven historical evaluation cases, one base seed, no fresh years. Pattern-scaling, physical units, area weights, time provenance and larger independent evaluations remain gaps.

validation.question: Can headline be retrospective20 including defects?
validation.status: Addressed transparently: main historical20 result retained, retrospective15 sensitivity recomputed from five pre-documented data exclusions; fresh heat reported separately. Broader fresh confirmation still needed.

theory.question: What does math establish?
theory.status: Quadratic risk identity and conditional perturbation bound; neither novelty nor universal tiny-k guarantee.
